name: Default First-Time Setup — Developer Edition via create-app
expected_behavior: Step 1: Resolve the CLI per Rule 3 (`conductor` on PATH, else `npx --yes …`; a global install only after asking); any version will do so far

Step 2: Run `conductor config list`. No profiles, no server named, no `CONDUCTOR_SERVER_URL` and no local server → default to Developer Edition (`https://developer.orkescloud.com`, profile `developer`) and say: Using Developer Edition; give me a URL to use another Conductor server, or say 'local'. With one working profile, use it; with several, use a working `developer` and say so, otherwise ask which one (one question)

Step 3: Developer Edition is Orkes (no probe needed). Check `conductor create-app --help` (Rule 3.5: too old → ask, then update), then `conductor create-app --server https://developer.orkescloud.com --profile developer` with a long timeout; tell the user to sign in and click **Approve** once the CLI prints `Opening <url>` (or beforehand, conditionally: if a browser window opens)
Step 4: Verify with `conductor --profile developer whoami` and `conductor --profile developer workflow list --json`
Step 5: Mention local OSS (`conductor server start` + a no-auth `localhost` profile) only as an option; do not set it up unasked
Step 6: Honor an explicit local-only, URL, or existing named-profile request instead of the default
success_criteria: Connection uses `conductor create-app` run by the agent; the user only signs in and approves. UI access-key creation plus `config save` is acceptable only as the timeout fallback

Developer Edition default is stated explicitly, not applied silently, and only when nothing else names a server (no profiles); with several profiles the agent uses a working `developer` and says so, otherwise asks which one
No local server or `localhost` profile is set up unasked
Agent never asks for credential values in chat and never reads profile YAML, the clipboard, or secret-bearing terminal input
Agent honors an explicit non-default target instead of forcing the Developer Edition default
